EP-M476T._provenance: Characterised on real hardware 2026-09-04 with the owner of a Japan-market EP-M476T (Reddit). Confirmed: read_key 0x364A over the D4 control channel; a full 0-255 EEPROM dump matching the ET-4800 layout, with main_waste [48,49,47]/63.46 reading 100.11% on a printer that was in fact reporting end of life, and addr 55 already holding 0x5E. write_key is NOT confirmed: rkey 0x364A spans groups using both Maribaya and Arantifo, and a no-op write probe was inconclusive because this firmware answers OK to a write whose value already matches, without checking the key. Maribaya is the ET-4800 family's and is tried first; if writes are refused, switch to Arantifo.
